name: Scheduled Reconciliation
summary: Compare two approved record sources in a durable Workflow and prepare an attributable exception report.
audience: Finance, operations, fulfillment, and compliance teams

requiredConnections.minimumScope: Read the approved primary records for one bounded reconciliation period
Read the approved comparison records for the same bounded period

handoffChecks.description: Confirm the period, time zone, match key, and material variance threshold.
Connect both record tools with fixed read-only endpoints and bounded result sizes.
Replace example evaluation facts with customer-approved reconciliation cases.
Create the schedule disabled, then have the process owner verify its next occurrence.
Run in suggest mode until exception precision and late-arrival behavior are measured.
